purpose: Exhaustive source-counterpart coverage, not a declaration of implemented visual fidelity or complete source feature parity.

method.inventory: Every definition imported by packages/elements/src/catalog.ts, cross-checked against public-api.json and custom-elements.json. Includes authored descriptors and generated-child roots; counts are not independent interaction-owner counts.

classifications.direct-analogue: Official source names a family with the same primary task/anatomy. Does not assert all variants, APIs, behavior or visual details are identical.
classifications.adaptation: Related source component(s), composition, subpart or task support a deliberate local translation. Not evidence of exact source-component parity.
classifications.no-source-analogue: No direct counterpart located in the examined selected public catalogue. Does not claim the entire vendor ecosystem lacks the feature. Apply shared theme foundations to local anatomy.
classifications.uncertain: Catalogue/generation/variant evidence is insufficient. Must resolve or disclose before claiming source fidelity.

method.generationBoundary: Current public catalogues establish counterpart availability. They do not retarget existing pinned source recipes, authorize Pro source access, or certify rendered parity. Spectrum means S2; Fluent core means current React v9 unless explicitly marked; Radix means Themes, not Primitives; shadcn means Rhea/Base; Astryx keeps the branded skin. Web Awesome current 3.14 availability is distinct from the historical free fixture. Fluent calendar/date/time mappings explicitly adapt official v8-derived compat packages using v9 dependencies; Fluent chart maps the separate v9 react-charts library, not legacy react-charting. The pinned showcase does not install those optional packages. Swatch mapping additionally uses pinned React 9.74.7 / SwatchPicker 9.6.1 primary implementation evidence.
method.checked: Catalogue membership, definition tags, source catalogue names, relevant local implementation contracts/styles and prior plans. No builds or browser sessions performed by this crosswalk pass.
method.resolvedUncertainty: All five earlier Fluent unknowns were resolved against official compat READMEs, DatePicker slot/types and separate v9 chart README/package metadata. They are adaptations with explicit source-generation and fixture boundaries; this does not upgrade visual verification coverage.
